## New

- Phone: on the PC's player, tap or drag the progress bar to jump in the track, set the volume by tapping or dragging its bar, and Mute (Unmute goes back to the level before).
- Phone: drag along the tab bar, or along a two-way switch such as Touchpad / Presenter, to change tabs.
- Phone: Remote and Shell have a Back button.
- Phone: in landscape the Remote takes the whole screen, so the touchpad is taller.

## Fixes

- Phone: the Remote's pointer moves more smoothly: its acceleration follows the finger's speed instead of jumping, and a swipe moves it as far on any phone.
